interpretation: Collection reports completed decisions per second including forced decisions; branch inference rows are separate.
Logical replay draws and within-update deduplicated processed rows are distinct learner metrics.
Production learner totals include periodic checkpoint writes and synchronization. Warmup and initial corpus/model load are excluded.
GPU-fenced phase timings change overlap and are not normal-run throughput. Inclusive phases contain child timings.
The matched-model probe excludes optimizer, teacher, checkpoint and shared board preparation/H2D. It does not compare training quality.
Detached precomputed history removes recurrent gradient flow only as a diagnostic and is not a proposed production optimization.
Disabling persistence is diagnostic only; it removes serialization/accessor copies, compression, checksums, writes, force and rename.
Pipeline idle is pending batch count zero, not measured GPU hardware idle.
JFR allocation weights are cumulative allocation estimates, not live memory. Native samples are host stacks, not kernel timings.
BFLOAT16 configuration yielded FLOAT16 GRU output tensors; internal kernel accumulation precision was not identified.

profile.timingSemantics: Diagnostic wall time with current-worker-stream event synchronization at phase boundaries. Each phase includes its ending fence overhead; the prior fence is reported separately. Optimizer timing explicitly waits for all parameter updates. Synchronization changes overlap and throughput; do not present this as normal-run throughput. Phase times sum across worker lanes and can exceed wall time with multiple devices. inclusive.* phases contain child phases and must not be added to them.

model-short-1.timingScope: Matched real CFR observations and identical resident DecisionDeviceBatch for both networks. Fixed loaded weights; no optimizer, teacher, replay sampling, model persistence or training-quality comparison. Each step includes graph construction, forward and optionally backward, and an explicit GPU completion event. Gradient clearing, shared board materialization/H2D, model load, corpus preparation and final tensor cleanup are excluded. CFR_FULL and CFR_HISTORY_ONLY include per-step history CPU packing/H2D through the production fullHistory method. CFR_PRECOMPUTED_HISTORY reuses identical detached history activations on device, removing recurrent forward and backward only for diagnosis. All outputs use the same diagnostic mean-square operation; Nano sums actor branch/candidate/riichi and value energies. Forward-only uses inference mode; forward/backward uses the production training blocks and precision. The full-history forward-only case is not the incremental production collector.
